import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEvaluationNaturality
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivLocallyClosed

/-!
# Base change of the divisor Grassmannian candidate

The candidate quotient commutes with arbitrary changes of test scheme.
Right exactness makes the comparison from the pulled-back kernel epimorphic;
canonical evaluation naturality then identifies the two cokernels. No flatness
of the test-scheme map is required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem mate_homEquiv
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    {L₁ : A ⥤ B} {R₁ : B ⥤ A} {L₂ : C ⥤ D} {R₂ : D ⥤ C}
    {G : A ⥤ C} {H : B ⥤ D}
    (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂)
    (α : TwoSquare G L₁ L₂ H) {M : A} {N : B} (f : L₁.obj M ⟶ N) :
    adj₂.homEquiv _ _ (α.app M ≫ H.map f) =
      G.map (adj₁.homEquiv _ _ f) ≫ (mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app N := by
  apply (adj₂.homEquiv _ _).symm.injective
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Adjunction.homEquiv_counit,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [mateEquiv_counit]
  erw [α.naturality_assoc]
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, ← H.map_comp]
  erw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

namespace Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T T' : Over S} {d : ℕ}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Canonical comparison from the pullback of a quotient's kernel to the
kernel of its pullback. -/
noncomputable def kernelPullbackMap {V : S.Modules}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient V d T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Modules.pullback ψ.left).obj (kernel q.q) ⟶
      kernel (pullbackAlong ψ q).q :=
  Modules.pullbackKernelComparison ψ.left q.q ≫
    (kernel.mapIso ((Modules.pullback ψ.left).map q.q) (pullbackAlong ψ q).q
      (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ) V) (Iso.refl _)
      (by simp [pullbackAlong])).hom

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem kernelPullbackMap_ι {V : S.Modules}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient V d T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    kernelPullbackMap q ψ ≫ kernel.ι (pullbackAlong ψ q).q =
      (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (kernel.ι q.q) ≫
        (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ) V).hom := by
  simp [kernelPullbackMap, kernel.mapIso]

/-- Pullback of the kernel surjects onto the kernel after pullback. -/
theorem kernelPullbackMap_epi {V : S.Modules}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient V d T) (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    Epi (kernelPullbackMap q ψ) := by
  haveI : Epi q.q := q.epi
  haveI : Epi (Modules.pullbackKernelComparison ψ.left q.q) :=
    Modules.epi_pullbackKernelComparison ψ.left q.q
  dsimp only [kernelPullbackMap]
  infer_instance

private noncomputable def candidatePullbackSquareIso (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :=
  (Modules.pullbackComp (pullback.snd π T'.hom) ψ.left) ≪≫
    Modules.pullbackCongr (quotBaseMap_snd π ψ).symm ≪≫
    (Modules.pullbackComp (quotBaseMap π ψ) (pullback.snd π T.hom)).symm

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The comparison of evaluation sources is epimorphic, which suffices for
comparison of their cokernels. -/
noncomputable def kernelEvaluationPullbackMap (L : X.Modules)
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj
        ((Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (kernel q.q)) ⟶
      (Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T'.hom)).obj
        (kernel (pullbackAlong ψ q).q) :=
  (candidatePullbackSquareIso (π := π) ψ).inv.app (kernel q.q) ≫
    (Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T'.hom)).map (kernelPullbackMap q ψ)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
theorem kernelEvaluationPullbackMap_epi (L : X.Modules)
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    (ψ : T' ⟶ T) : Epi (kernelEvaluationPullbackMap L q ψ) := by
  haveI := kernelPullbackMap_epi q ψ
  dsimp only [kernelEvaluationPullbackMap]
  exact epi_comp' inferInstance
    (Functor.map_epi (Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T'.hom)) (kernelPullbackMap q ψ))

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Evaluation on the kernel is compatible with arbitrary test-scheme
pullback through the canonical epimorphism of kernel sources. -/
theorem kernelEvaluation_pullback (L : X.Modules)
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map (kernelEvaluation L q) ≫
        (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ) L).hom =
      kernelEvaluationPullbackMap L q ψ ≫ kernelEvaluation L (pullbackAlong ψ q) := by
  apply (cancel_epi ((candidatePullbackSquareIso (π := π) ψ).hom.app
    (kernel q.q))).mp
  simp only [kernelEvaluationPullbackMap, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
  apply ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (pullback.snd π T'.hom)).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [← Category.assoc ((candidatePullbackSquareIso (π := π) ψ).hom.app
    (kernel q.q))]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  rw [mate_homEquiv
    (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T.hom))
    (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T'.hom))
    (candidatePullbackSquareIso (π := π) ψ).hom (kernelEvaluation L q)]
  simp only [kernelEvaluation, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [kernelPullbackMap_ι_assoc]
  rw [← canonicalBaseChangeMap_quotBaseSquare_comp π ψ L]
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The divisor Grassmannian candidate cokernel commutes with arbitrary
changes of test scheme. -/
noncomputable def candidatePullbackIso (L : X.Modules)
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)) ≅
      cokernel (kernelEvaluation L (pullbackAlong ψ q)) := by
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)) :=
    (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (quotBaseMap π ψ)).leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  haveI := kernelEvaluationPullbackMap_epi L q ψ
  exact (asIso (cokernelComparison (kernelEvaluation L q)
      (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)))).symm ≪≫
    asIso (cokernel.map
      ((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map (kernelEvaluation L q))
      (kernelEvaluation L (pullbackAlong ψ q))
      (kernelEvaluationPullbackMap L q ψ)
      (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ) L).hom
      (kernelEvaluation_pullback L q ψ))

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The candidate base-change isomorphism respects the actual quotient of
the pulled-back line bundle. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem candidatePullbackIso_quotient (L : X.Modules)
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map (candidateQuotient L q) ≫
        (candidatePullbackIso L q ψ).hom =
      (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ) L).hom ≫
        candidateQuotient L (pullbackAlong ψ q) := by
  simp only [candidatePullbackIso, candidateQuotient, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, asIso_inv]
  rw [← π_comp_cokernelComparison]
  simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, cokernel.map, cokernel.π_desc]

end Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

end AlgebraicGeometry
